UserBackup.title: UserBackup
UserBackup.description: Cloud backup of a user's Foco local state and modification timestamps.

data.description: Map of Foco storage keys to bounded JSON-serialized string values.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the latest local modification.

serverUpdatedAt.description: Server-assigned timestamp verified by Firestore security rules.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Non-PII social snapshot of a user visible only to the owner and linked friends.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Public display name shown to friends (1 to 60 chars).

photoDataUrl.description: Empty string, HTTPS avatar URL, or safe raster base64 image data URI.

totalXp.description: Total XP accumulated by the user.

levelTitle.description: Title corresponding to the user's current level.

friendCode.description: Deterministic alphanumeric friend code shared manually to connect.

isOnline.description: Whether the user session is currently active.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest heartbeat or disconnect.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile snapshot update.

FriendCode.title: FriendCode
FriendCode.description: Exact-lookup index mapping a shareable friend code to a user's UID and display name.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this friend code.

displayName.description: Display name shown when resolving the code.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Bidirectional friend connection or pending invite keyed by sorted pairId.

users.description: Sorted 2-element array [uidA, uidB] participating in this friendship.

requesterUid.description: UID of the user who initiated the friend request.

recipientUid.description: UID of the user who received the friend request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest status change.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user Foco sync snapshot strictly owned by {userId}.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: Non-PII profile, XP level, and online presence readable by the owner and friends.

/friendCodes/{code}.description: Exact-get lookup from friend code to user UID (listing disabled).

/friendships/{pairId}.description: Friend connections and pending requests accessible only to pair participants.
